L146: ## Davis Scholarship
L147: 
L148: All students who are US citizens applying to any UWC through the U.S. national committee are automatically considered for the merit-based Davis Scholarship. A limited number of full-tuition places are available at UWC-USA for students who are not awarded a Davis Scholarship.
L149: 
L150: #### U.S. Citizens Receive $25,000 per Year
L151: 
L152: Davis Scholars receive a merit award of $25,000 per year applied toward tuition regardless of which UWC they attend.
L153: #### Twenty-Five Places for UWC-USA
L154: 
L155: These scholarships are limited and competitive. Twenty-five places are reserved for students to attend UWC-USA
L156: 
L157: #### Two Places Reserved for Other Campuses
L158: 
L159: Typically two scholarship places are reserved for US students at each of the other campuses.

L162: ## Tuition Costs
L163: 
L164: All UWCs work collaboratively with U.S. families to award as much need-based aid as possible. At UWC we believe every family should pay what they can, but no family should pay what they cannot.
L165: ###### Cost of Attendance
L166: 
L167: UWC-USA tuition for the 2027-2028 academic year is $59,800. The cost of attendance at any of the other 17 schools varies considerably, ranging from just under $25,000 to a little over $75,000 per year, depending on economies, exchange rates, and government policies related to funding in different countries.
L168: ###### Need-based Financial Aid
L169: 
L170: School and Student Services is an organization that calculates family contributions by examining personal assets, incomes, and tax histories.
L171: 
L172: ###### Scholarships
L173: 
L174: For U.S. Davis Scholars, cost of attendance is reduced by $25,000 per year, and to cover any balance, students are eligible to apply for need-based aid.
L175: ###### Beyond Tuition Costs
L176: 
L177: Students who qualify for significant need-based financial assistance may also qualify for travel reimbursement, spending money, and other miscellaneous expenses.
